claim: Nallur Sri Kandaswamy Devasthanam identifies the Jaffna temple as a Tamil Saiva shrine dedicated to Lord Murugan; its institutional account identifies the Vel in the sanctum as Nallur Kandaswamy.
bounded_by: Current institutional religious identity and temple self-description only. Medieval foundation dates, successive destructions and political patronage require independent historical anchors.
notes: Placed as a dezoom endpoint for the Kandy Kataragama comparison; it is not evidence that Kandy and Nallur ritual practices are identical.
